name: Bristol Electronics
old_description: Since 1980, Bristol Electronics has been a leading independent stocking distributor.
about:
Founded in 1980 in Trevor, Wisconsin, Bristol Electronics operates as an independent stocking distributor of electronic components. The company’s founding year and location are confirmed in its own materials, though no founder names or ownership structure are disclosed.

The distributor maintains a 30,000-square-foot facility housing more than 1 million stock-keeping units (SKUs). It offers off-the-shelf inventory with same-day shipping on over 250,000 components, and leverages a network of over 1,000 global suppliers for non-stock items. The company reports more than 3 billion parts in stock across 28,000 manufacturer lines.

Bristol Electronics serves customers across the electronics supply chain, including original equipment manufacturers, contract manufacturers, and design engineers seeking semiconductors, passive components, and integrated circuits. Specific industry verticals are not detailed in the available information.

The company emphasizes a customer-first service model, highlighting decades of industry experience, a knowledgeable sales team, and a commitment to reliable supply and fast turnaround as its primary differentiators.
